errorCard.body.fileInUse.clearData: Another program is holding one of SavePoint's files open, so it wasn't removed. Everything else was removed. Close the program, then delete what's left yourself.
errorCard.body.fileInUse.freeUpSpace: Another program, such as a backup tool, is holding a snapshot file open, so freeing up space stopped. Close it and try again.
errorCard.body.fileInUse.moveSnapshots: Another program is holding an old snapshot file open, so it wasn't removed. Your snapshots moved and SavePoint uses the new folder. Close the program, then delete what's left yourself.
errorCard.body.fileInUse.snapshot: Another program is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again. Earlier snapshots are untouched.
errorCard.body.fileInUse.switch: Another program is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again. SavePoint picks up where it left off.
